title: Safe to Send? Student Data and AI Services

zones.label: Send it
facts: The published text of an open textbook chapter: It is public and holds no student data.
A rubric prompt template: It holds no student data.

zones.label: Fix it first
facts: A class's quiz scores with student names: Names make the scores personal data, so anonymize or get approval first.

zones.label: Never send it
facts: A spreadsheet of grades with student ID numbers: It is identifiable and sensitive.
A student's photograph: It identifies a person.
An email thread with a parent about a student: It is private and identifies a student.

quiz.question: Which chute holds the published text of an open textbook chapter and a rubric prompt template?
quiz.explanation: Both are public or hold no student data.

quiz.question: Which chute holds a class's quiz scores listed with student names?
quiz.explanation: Names make the scores personal data.

quiz.question: Which chute holds a spreadsheet of grades with student ID numbers?
Which chute holds an email thread with a parent about a student?
quiz.explanation: It is private and identifies a student.
